assumptions.statement: The public site package does not yet contain verified official site/key-area polygons or project-specific regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal, heritage, fire-safety, and engineering-condition datasets.

No participant-controlled deliverable is held open by this assumption.
assumptions.impact: This organizer-supplied data gap limits statutory, approval, parcel-level, and precision uses only. Under the official Skill and formal guide it does not block formal intake or content scoring and does not reduce participant evidence completion.
assumptions.replacement_action: When verified official polygons and controls are published or cleared, replace provisional constraints and rerun topology, EPSG:4548 metrics, figures, PDFs, HTML, manifest finalization, and self-check before any statutory or implementation use.
